question.text: What is the maximum permissible duration for keeping an NFO open for subscription, except for ELSS schemes?

explanation.text: The Logic: Mutual fund schemes other than ELSS remain open for subscription during their NFO for a maximum of 15 days. The Trap: 30 days is a common distractor because the ELSS exception allows a longer NFO window. Candidates confuse the general 15-day NFO rule with the ELSS carve-out. Note: Mark the exact opening and closing dates when an NFO is announced — the 15-day window is tight and late applications may be rejected.
